title: Narrative Command During State Elections
challenge: Managing digital reputation and public conversation across four state elections at once — Jharkhand, Delhi, Maharashtra, and Bihar, where a single unaddressed narrative could shift perception faster than any campaign message could recover it. The mandate wasn't visibility alone, but consistency across multiple regions, languages, and platforms.
solution: Deployed a coordinated reputation management framework built to run continuously through the entire election cycle. Execution combined proactive narrative reinforcement, real-time misinformation control, government initiative amplification, and multilingual engagement across every region in play.
result: The framework sustained 84,000+ comments and 280,000+ strategic engagements across the election period, with 15,000+ daily interactions maintained throughout. Negative conversations were addressed before they gained ground, while high-visibility discussions stayed aligned with campaign messaging across all four states.

title: Visibility Through Participation
challenge: Making Good Day part of authentic public conversation at Mahakumbh, one of the world's largest cultural gatherings, without relying on advertising to get there. The objective was cultural participation, not product promotion, inside a moment that couldn't be bought or interrupted.
solution: Activated a narrative-led community strategy built around #AGoodDayAtMahaKumbh2025, combining creator participation, organic conversation amplification, and emotion-first storytelling. Instead of promoting the product, the campaign seeded genuine conversations around shared experience.
result: The campaign drove 14M+ digital interactions and 15M+ conversation impressions, with 70%+ positive audience sentiment sustained throughout. Britannia successfully connected with one of India's largest cultural moments while staying authentic to the conversation, not interrupting it.

title: Recommendations That Drive Decisions
challenge: Establishing Fixderma as a credible, community-recommended skincare brand across the platforms where consumers actually research before they buy. Positioning had to be earned through trust, not promotional messaging, inside conversations people already relied on.
solution: Combined online reputation management, community engagement, and educational content marketing to build authority across Quora, Reddit, and X. Execution focused on expert-led discourse and evidence-based, scientific content rather than direct promotion.
result: The combined ORM and content strategy grew brand mentions and recommendation visibility across organic skincare communities, while negative discussion share declined. Fixderma became part of the high-intent conversations where purchase decisions actually happen, backed by 2,400+ strategic comments and 45+ long-form educational threads.

title: Trusted Before The Checkout
challenge: Becoming the trusted recommendation inside real consumer conversations, where comfort is compared and validated long before checkout. Modern buyers don't search for brands first, they search for problems, and YOHO needed to be part of that conversation early.
solution: Combined Generative Engine Optimization and community marketing to seed search-indexed, narrative-led conversations around comfort, affordability, and everyday use. Execution ran continuously across Quora and Reddit, avoiding promotional language in favour of authentic, human-first participation.
result: The GEO and community marketing strategy embedded YOHO inside the conversations people already trusted, and inside the search results they were already reading. What started as search visibility became sustained presence across the discussions that shape buying decisions before customers ever reach the website.

title: Scaling Digital Presence For A Category Leader
challenge: Growing digital visibility and lead quality for India's leading accounting education ecosystem, while simplifying course discovery across an expanding network of learners, partners, and institutions. The brand's offline credibility hadn't yet translated into a matching digital presence.
solution: Combined social media management and performance marketing across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X, driven by 17 UGC and influencer collaborations, 8 campaigns, and 16 trend-led activations over 12 months. Organic growth and paid reach were run as one connected system, with landing pages and lead capture built to convert the attention generated across every platform.
result: Total social following and engagement grew 329% across platforms, with YouTube subscribers up 558% and Facebook followers up 434%. The strategy reached 12.3M+ unique users and generated 18.4M+ impressions over 12 months, converting into 3,675+ qualified website leads and 527+ GST webinar registrations.
